overview: The Medford Historical Commission evaluated demolition applications for three residential properties and received updates on city preservation projects. The Commission determined 67-69 Court Street to be historically significant while finding 587 Winthrop Street and 64 Myrtle Street not historically significant.

items.title: 56 Wareham Street
items.summary: Tabled and removed the item from the agenda because no representative was present.

items.title: 67-69 Court Street
items.summary: Accepted the demolition application as complete and voted to find the house and carriage house historically significant, advancing the application to a public hearing.

items.title: 587 Winthrop Street
items.summary: Accepted the demolition application as complete, but a motion to determine historic significance failed.

items.title: 64 Myrtle Street
items.summary: Accepted the demolition application as complete and determined the property is not historically significant, with plans to document the structure before demolition.

items.title: Committee Updates and Administrative Business
items.summary: Received updates regarding the CLG annual report, Cross Street Cemetery restoration and archaeological studies, Thomas Brooks Park, local survey projects, and the Brooks Estate, and approved meeting minutes.
